notes: Shopify storefront (nicobar.com), robots.txt allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow - used direct HTTP fetch (collections.json, products.json?limit=250, homepage HTML nav dump) throughout; Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome not needed. Scoped to Home (non-apparel): main nav's 'Home & Living' mega-menu links exactly one New Arrivals PLP for Home - /collections/new-arrival-house-home ('New Arrivals House & Home') - confirmed by homepage HTML href scan. Verified via products.json?limit=250 exhaustive enumeration: 137 products. product_type breakdown is almost entirely Home-vertical (Coffee & Tea Sets, Decor, Cushions, Home Fragrance, Candle & Oil Warmers, Serveware, Bowls, Plates, Barware, Vases, Table Runners/Napkins/Linen, Drinkware); 9 items carry Shopify's generic 'Apparel & Accessories' product_type (gift sets and bag/home charms) but every one of them is tagged Filtercategory_House & Home (and Filterclass_Home Accent / Bath Accessories / Gift Sets) confirming they are genuinely merchandised as home-decor/gift items, not clothing - kept in the count since this is PLP-level extraction of the site's own collection, not product-level re-filtering. Enumerated the full collections.json catalog (1247 collections across 5 pages) and checked for other Home-scoped 'new arrivals' style PLPs ('new-in', 'just arrived', 'latest', 'new season', etc.) - found only apparel/jewelry-scoped siblings (new-arrivals-all-categories is a mixed roll-up across apparel+home+jewellery so excluded as not Home-exclusive; new-arrivals-accessories, new-arrivals-jewellery, new-arrivals-womens, mens-new-arrivals, new-arrivals-t-shirts/travel/women/bottoms/kurtas/shirts/tops, new-collections, new-for-you, new-season-prints, new-year-looks are all apparel/accessories/jewelry scoped per title and nav placement). No sub-structure (e.g. 'Kitchen New Arrivals' / 'Decor New Arrivals') is exposed by the site for Home - only one undifferentiated Home New Arrivals listing exists, so sub_category equals the site's own listing name rather than inventing children.
